title: Hanasato Minori — A Dream Lost In The Crowds〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: A Dream Lost In The Crowds（4★）

rows.Line: The Lumina Forum - Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Five, six, seven, eight!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hmm... I still keep getting stuck on this hand motion...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But we're doing that show stream this weekend, so I've gotta keep trying until I get it right!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Again. I'll try going a little slower this time!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Phew...
I think I'm starting to get the hang of it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'll try performing the whole thing next.
But before I do, where's my water... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Hi, Minori!>
<Whatcha doin'?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh, I'm on camera right now...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hi, everyone!
I'm MORE MORE JUMP!'s Minori Hanasato!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was just practicing a dance routine that we're gonna perform during the show stream we're scheduled to do on our channel.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Wait, you're doing a show?>
<I'll come watch!>
<My schedule's open.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, so many of you want to see it!
Hehe. Thanks so much♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I promise to practice lots and lots to make sure that you guys all get to have fun! Ready?! Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Here we go!>
<She's so cute lol>
<I can't wait to see you dance, Minori.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <Watching Minori really does cheer me up.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hehe. That's so kind.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Alright, I'm gonna get back to practice, and make lots of people smile!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Anyway, now that I've had a chance to take a break, I shouldー

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh, it's Akarin!>
<They cut away from Minori lol.>
<Akari!!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Huh...?!
They changed cameras?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wish they could've watched me practice some more.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've got a great idea!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hi, everyone!
It's time for another MORE MORE JUMP! stream!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Starting right now... We're gonna have a surprise dance practice!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<No way!!>
<I got the notification and came right away!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're sorry for starting this all of a sudden and surprising you guys.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we literally just decided to do this stream a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori was the one who suggested it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I thought our show would be more fun if everyone had a chance to watch us practice for it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because you guys watching is a huge source of encouragement for us!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I'm gonna root for you like crazy!>
<Sounds like a win-win idea.>
<Thanks so much for letting us watch you practice!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Today, we're gonna practice the dance for a song we'll be performing during our show. We hope you watch until the end.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're falling behind a bit, Shizuku.
And Minori, you're rushing ahead slightly.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Listen to the music and get a good grasp of the rhythm!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Got it!
Okay!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<You all coach each other as you practice?>
<You can do it!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That hand motion looks much better now compared with last time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks! I practiced a ton on my own.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I feel like I'm not staying completely on-axis while I turn. Can we try doing that part again...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, I'll focus on that this time.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I thought you did really well just now.>
<You girls work so hard.>
<They're super serious...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I think I nailed it just now!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<You were all in perfect sync!>
<This is on the level of a real show.>
<Great performance!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We were able to put on a good performance because of all your cheering and support.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Having that little bit of tension made it a good practice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Again, we know this was really sudden, so thanks for tuning in! What did you guys think of our practice stream?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I really admire how hard you all work!>
<Thanks for having this surprise practice!>
<I feel like trying harder now.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hehe. It looks like we were able to encourage them. I'm so glad.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
So many kind comments.
I'm sure we all feel so encouraged.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're gonna maintain this momentum and turn our mini-concert into the best show ever. So, you guys better come and watch!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I will!!>
<Good luck with practice after this!>
<I have no choice but to come and watch!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
Anyway, let's call things here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks for watching until the very end!
See you again during the show! Bye bye♪
